title: How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry Danny Baer, Head of Revenue & Investments at Meanwhile, explains how his Bermuda-based company built the world's first fully licensed life insurance carrier that runs entirely on Bitcoin, holding its regulatory capital in Bitcoin and paying out policies in Bitcoin. This post How Sam Altman-Backed Meanwhile Is Disrupting the $20T Life Insurance Industry first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
